deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Prevents the accidental or unauthorized destruction of the Vertex AI Index resource, which could lead to data loss or service disruption.

description.rationale: This field only provides a human-readable description of the index and does not influence access control, data handling, or network security configurations.

display_name.description: The display name of the Index. The name can be up to 128 characters long and can consist of any UTF-8 characters.
display_name.rationale: This parameter is solely used for visual identification within the UI and has no bearing on the underlying security posture or data protection of the resource.

index_update_method.description:
The update method to use with this Index. The value must be the followings. If not set, BATCH_UPDATE will be used by default.
* BATCH_UPDATE: user can call indexes.patch with files on Cloud Storage of datapoints to update.
* STREAM_UPDATE: user can call indexes.upsertDatapoints/DeleteDatapoints to update the Index and the updates will be applied in corresponding DeployedIndexes in nearly real-time.
index_update_method.rationale: rationale: This determines whether updates are processed in batch or streaming modes. It dictates data processing logic, not the security or encryption mechanisms of the data in transit or at rest.

labels.description:
The labels with user-defined metadata to organize your Indexes.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for resource organization and billing categorization. They do not govern IAM policies, encryption, or network access boundaries.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: While it dictates the structural location of the resource, the project ID itself is an organizational boundary identifier rather than a direct security control parameter.

region.description: The region of the index. eg us-central1
region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

encryption_spec.description: Customer-managed encryption key spec for an Index. If set, this Index and all sub-resources of this Index will be secured by this key.

encryption_spec.kms_key_name.description: Required. The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer managed encryption key used to protect a resource. Has the form: 'projects/my-project/locations/my-region/keyRings/my-kr/cryptoKeys/my-key'. The key needs to be in the same region as where the compute resource is created.
encryption_spec.kms_key_name.rationale: Required for enforcing Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK). This directly secures the Index and all its sub-resources, ensuring data confidentiality at rest.

metadata.description:
Additional information about the Index.
Although this field is not marked as required in the API specification, it is currently required when creating an Index and must be provided.
Attempts to create an Index without this field will result in an API error.

metadata.contents_delta_uri.description:
Allows inserting, updating  or deleting the contents of the Matching Engine Index.
The string must be a valid Cloud Storage directory path. If this
field is set when calling IndexService.UpdateIndex, then no other
Index field can be also updated as part of the same call.
The expected structure and format of the files this URI points to is
described at https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/matching-engine/using-matching-engine#input-data-format
metadata.contents_delta_uri.rationale: Defines the data source URI. Delivery and storage endpoint URIs that ingest data require schema enforcement and must meet secure-storage platform standards to prevent sensitive reference exposures.

metadata.is_complete_overwrite.description:
If this field is set together with contentsDeltaUri when calling IndexService.UpdateIndex,
then existing content of the Index will be replaced by the data from the contentsDeltaUri.
metadata.is_complete_overwrite.rationale: This boolean flag controls whether data updates overwrite existing content, directly touching on data integrity and destructive loss or mutation controls.

metadata.config.description: The configuration of the Matching Engine Index.

metadata.config.approximate_neighbors_co.description:
The default number of neighbors to find via approximate search before exact reordering is
performed. Exact reordering is a procedure where results returned by an
approximate search algorithm are reordered via a more expensive distance computation.
Required if tree-AH algorithm is used.
metadata.config.approximate_neighbors_co.rationale: Algorithmic parameters and limits on resource queries are architectural constraints governed to prevent resource exhaustion or denial-of-service vectors.

metadata.config.dimensions.description: The number of dimensions of the input vectors.
metadata.config.dimensions.rationale: Model dimension configurations define structural resource capacity and operational sizing limits to prevent over-provisioning or unbounded resource consumption.

metadata.config.distance_measure_type.description:
The distance measure used in nearest neighbor search. The value must be one of the followings:
* SQUARED_L2_DISTANCE: Euclidean (L_2) Distance
* L1_DISTANCE: Manhattan (L_1) Distance
* COSINE_DISTANCE: Cosine Distance. Defined as 1 - cosine similarity.
* DOT_PRODUCT_DISTANCE: Dot Product Distance. Defined as a negative of the dot product
metadata.config.distance_measure_type.rationale: Enums require explicit configuration policies to avoid silent default vulnerabilities associated with unspecified or default sentinel values.

metadata.config.feature_norm_type.description:
Type of normalization to be carried out on each vector. The value must be one of the followings:
* UNIT_L2_NORM: Unit L2 normalization type
* NONE: No normalization type is specified.
metadata.config.feature_norm_type.rationale: Enforcing explicit selection for enum configuration fields prevents insecure default states or unspecified sentinels.

metadata.config.shard_size.description:
Index data is split into equal parts to be processed. These are called "shards".
The shard size must be specified when creating an index. The value must be one of the followings:
* SHARD_SIZE_SMALL: Small (2GB)
* SHARD_SIZE_MEDIUM: Medium (20GB)
* SHARD_SIZE_LARGE: Large (50GB)
metadata.config.shard_size.rationale: Resource sizing and sharding tiers govern capacity allocation and infrastructure limits, making them valid targets for cost and resource-exhaustion policies.

metadata.config.algorithm_config.description: The configuration with regard to the algorithms used for efficient search. This field may be required based on your configuration.

metadata.config.algorithm_config.brute_f.description:
Configuration options for using brute force search, which simply implements the
standard linear search in the database for each query.

metadata.config.algorithm_config.tree_ah.description:
Configuration options for using the tree-AH algorithm (Shallow tree + Asymmetric Hashing).
Please refer to this paper for more details: https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.10396
Number of embeddings on each leaf node. The default value is 1000 if not set.
metadata.config.algorithm_config.tree_ah.rationale: Node and embedding count thresholds control resource scaling and density, falling under performance and resource exhaustion governance.

metadata.config.algorithm_config.tree_ah.description:
The default percentage of leaf nodes that any query may be searched. Must be in
range 1-100, inclusive. The default value is 10 (means 10%) if not set.
metadata.config.algorithm_config.tree_ah.rationale: An algorithmic tuning parameter defining the number of embeddings on each leaf node for the tree-AH algorithm. It impacts performance, not security.
